name: channel
purpose: Inspect channel configurations by native abilityId within a fixed payout scope.

fields.name: abilityId

limitations: One-based pageNum with stride 100; qualified widths 1 through 100 permit aligned local hole probes. Native totalCount and totalPages do not control traversal or completeness.
Only IPAY_RS_510090020 with the verified debit account not exists record failure is classified as a hole. Other business failures, authentication, transport and schema errors remain fatal.

The host short_page strategy owns large-stride traversal, local hole discovery and latest-five history with newest-only revalidation. Two successful empty batches terminate normally. This endpoint may instead repeat its already-read short last page: two later large requests must reproduce that complete native page at the same width, with original request/response echoes retained as two_clamped_batches. Repeated full pages or unqualified echo mismatches remain failures.
Acquire the chosen payout scope before applying all eight exact local filters in live and offline views. No business filter is silently sent to change acquisition scope.
Native abilityId is the primary key. Identical repeated records are deduplicated; same-key conflicting contents remain a hard failure.

The accepted contract is completion of short_page forward traversal. Backend omissions and uncertain business-wide completeness are tolerated; native total equality and cross-width completeness proofs are not publication gates. coverage_basis=accepted_short_page describes this acceptance, not a proof of the backend dataset.
All native fields, nested values, types and first-identity response order remain unchanged. No synthetic ID, timestamp winner, Get or new Duckdog import.
Live does not publish; refresh publishes a successfully completed accepted traversal and offline replays it. Unknown source errors, invalid records and identity conflicts preserve the prior capture.
